deploy.title: Deploy a model
deploy.description: Runs an inference engine on a GPU node and exposes an OpenAI-compatible endpoint protected by an API key.

sections.advancedHint: GPUs, context length, residency, swap group and domain. The defaults suit most models.

fields.name: Name
fields.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Used in the endpoint URL.
fields.modelHint: A reference the engine can pull. Pick a suggestion or paste your own.
fields.gpusHint: How many GPUs the engine may use. "all" leaves it to the engine.
fields.contextHint: Maximum tokens per request. Leave empty to use the engine default.
fields.quantizationHint: Optional. For example awq, gptq or fp8.
fields.residencyHint: On demand stops the engine when idle and starts it on the first request.
fields.idleMinutesHint: How long the engine stays loaded without requests.
fields.swapGroupHint: Models sharing a name on the same GPU take turns: waking one stops the resident one to free VRAM.
fields.domainHint: Serve the endpoint on your own hostname.
fields.hfTokenHint: Only needed for gated models. Stored encrypted, never shown again.

summary.incomplete: Name the model and choose what to run to see what will be created.

errors.name: Use lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.
errors.model: Choose or enter a model reference.
errors.context: Enter a positive number of tokens.
errors.idle: Enter a positive number of minutes.
errors.swapGroup: Use lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.

toast.title: Deploying "{{name}}".
toast.description: The engine is downloading and loading the model.

gpus.title: No GPU node has reported in yet
gpus.description: Nodes with an NVIDIA GPU and driver show up here with their VRAM. Install the NVIDIA driver and nvidia-container-toolkit on an Ubuntu node and it appears within a minute.

models.title: No models deployed yet
models.description: Deploy Ollama, vLLM or llama.cpp on a GPU node and get an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with its own API key.

cache.title: Nothing cached yet
cache.description: Downloaded model weights are kept here so a redeploy starts fast. Deploy a model to fill it.

switch.gpuHint: Ollama, vLLM or llama.cpp on an NVIDIA GPU. Best for large models.
switch.cpuHint: A small model on this server's CPU and RAM, with hard limits. No GPU needed.

deploy.description: Runs a small model on this server's CPU with hard CPU and memory limits, and an OpenAI-compatible endpoint protected by an API key.
deploy.catalogNote: Curated list verified on {{date}}. Speeds and memory are estimates. Your server downloads the weights directly from Hugging Face when you deploy.
deploy.customRepoHint: A GGUF repository, optionally with a quantization suffix.
deploy.customFileHint: Optional when the quantization suffix picks exactly one file.
deploy.unloadHint: Stops the engine after a while without requests and frees its memory. The next request starts it again.
deploy.warn: This will use up to {{cpus}} CPUs and {{memory}} of memory on this server and about {{disk}} of disk. Other apps keep priority.
deploy.toast: The weights are downloading from Hugging Face, then the model loads.

license.title: Licence not reviewed
license.generic: This repository is not on the curated list and its licence was not reviewed. You are responsible for complying with it.
license.ack: I have read the licence and accept responsibility for using this model.

limits.cpuHint: A hard cap. The model gets low priority when other apps need the CPU.
limits.memoryHint: A hard cap with no swap. At least {{floor}} always stays free for other workloads.

fit.speed: Expected speed: {{range}} tokens per second. This is an estimate, run the benchmark for the real number.
fit.disk: The download needs about {{size}} of disk.

benchmark.title: Benchmark
benchmark.hint: Runs a few short prompts and stops after a time limit. It uses the CPU you gave this model and never runs by itself.
benchmark.notReady: Load the model first. A benchmark never starts a stopped model.
benchmark.onlyEstimate: Estimated {{range}} tokens per second. Not measured yet.

detail.caps: This model may use up to {{cpus}} CPUs and {{memory}} of memory, with no swap and low priority. If the server runs short, this model is stopped before your apps.
detail.idleExplain: Idle unload: with on demand residency the engine stops after the idle time and frees its memory and CPU. The downloaded weights stay on disk, so the next request only waits for the model to load again.

residencyCard.title: Residency
residencyCard.aboutResidencyBody: On demand stops the engine after the idle time, freeing its VRAM, and starts it on the first request, which waits while the engine loads (up to APP_MODEL_WAKE_WAIT, then a 503 with Retry-After). Ollama keeps models loaded forever, so the container is stopped to unload it.
residencyCard.notUsed: Not used since it went idle.
residencyCard.aboutSwapBody: Models sharing this name on the same node/GPU cannot both be resident. Waking one stops the group's current resident model first to free VRAM.

add.title: Add an inference endpoint
add.description: Use a model server you run yourself, such as Ollama, LM Studio or an MLX server on a Mac. Requests go through the gateway with scoped keys, limits and usage tracking.
add.registerAnyway: You can still register it now. Levelrail keeps checking and shows when it comes online.

fields.urlHint: Reachable from the control plane, for example a WireGuard mesh address.
fields.name: Name
fields.nameHint: Optional. Taken from the address when empty.
fields.credentialPlaceholder: Leave empty if the server has none

openai.label: OpenAI-compatible
openai.hint: LM Studio, MLX, vLLM, llama.cpp or a cloud API. Models are listed from /v1/models.

errors.url: Enter an http or https address without a username or password.
errors.name: Use lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.

health.title: Health
health.privateOff: Internal destinations are off on this control plane, so only public https servers can be reached.

credential.title: API key
credential.set: A key is stored and sent with every request to this endpoint.
credential.notSet: No key is stored. Requests are sent without credentials.

routing.title: Fallback
routing.description: Off by default. When on, requests go to another model while this endpoint is down or slower than the budget.
routing.hint: The budget is the time to the first response bytes. Without a budget, only errors and an unreachable endpoint trigger the fallback.

fix.ollamaBind: Ollama only listens on localhost by default. On the server, bind it to the network address:

check_port.title: Nothing answered on that port
check_port.body: Check the port and that the server is running. Ollama uses 11434, LM Studio 1234. Choose the matching API type and test again.

check_network.title: The server did not answer in time
check_network.body: The machine may be asleep, off the network, or a firewall may block this port. Wake it, check the mesh or LAN connection and the firewall, then re-check.

check_host.title: The host name does not resolve
check_host.body: Check the spelling, or use the IP address on your WireGuard mesh or LAN, then test again.

use_other_address.title: That address is never allowed
use_other_address.body: Link-local and cloud metadata addresses cannot be used as an inference endpoint. Use the machine's mesh or LAN address instead.

enable_internal.title: Internal destinations are off
enable_internal.body: This address is private. An operator must allow internal destinations on the control plane with {{env}}, restart it, then re-check.

set_credential.title: The server rejected the credential
set_credential.body: Enter the server's API key. It is stored encrypted and sent only to this endpoint.

check_api_type.title: The server does not answer like this API type
check_api_type.body: Pick the other API type (Ollama or OpenAI-compatible) and test again.

use_http_or_trust.title: The TLS certificate is not trusted
use_http_or_trust.body: Use a certificate from a trusted authority, or a private http address on your mesh, then re-check.

pull_model.title: The server has no models yet
pull_model.body: Pull or load a model on the server, then re-check to list it.

check_server.title: The server reported an error
check_server.body: Look at the server's own log, then re-check once it is healthy.
